name: Cite Check
description: Flags problem cites: missing or vague author quals, weak sources, date and author mismatches, dead links, DOIs that point elsewhere.
author: CardMirror

permissionReasons.doc.read: To read the cites in your open documents.
permissionReasons.doc.events: To re-check cites as you edit.
permissionReasons.doc.annotate: To underline problem cites, like spellcheck.
permissionReasons.ui.panel: To list every cite problem in one place.
permissionReasons.ui.contextMenu: To add “Verify this cite” to the right-click menu.
permissionReasons.ui.notices: To tell you when an online check finishes.
permissionReasons.files.data: To remember findings you chose to ignore, inside the file.
permissionReasons.net.fetch: Only when you run “Verify sources”: to look cites up on Crossref and OpenAlex and open the cited pages. It sends titles, author names and links, nothing else.
